Tom Sawyer a nigger stealer!"}, {"id": "043-036-0022", "tag": "p", "text": "“Oh, shucks!” I says; “you’re joking.”", "sha256": "0938bf685b92a71fa10d0bf54dea8b19db5355614698cc3e09737d548e945b20", "source_location": "div.chapter[38]/*[22]", "source_html": "“Oh, shucks!” I says; “you’re joking.”"}, {"id": "043-036-0023", "tag": "p", "text": "“I ain’t joking, either.”", "sha256": "ba7ef2b03a95a327069eaae4f86032bed0ea711993dfe4721bc5530fd1368149", "source_location": "div.chapter[38]/*[23]", "source_html": "“I ain’t joking, either.”"}, {"id": "043-036-0024", "tag": "p", "text": "“Well, then,” I says, “joking or no joking, if you hear anything said about a runaway nigger, don’t forget to remember that you don’t know nothing about him, and I don’t know nothing about him.”", "sha256": "63d9c1f08705479c340da3822e32bb0a7b429477f84770929d619abee79693cf", "source_location": "div.chapter[38]/*[24]", "source_html": "“Well, then,” I says, “joking or no joking, if you hear anything said about a runaway nigger, don’t forget to remember that you don’t know nothing about him, and I don’t know nothing about him.”"}, {"id": "043-036-0025", "tag": "p", "text": "Then we took the trunk and put it in my wagon, and he drove off his way and I drove mine. But of course I forgot all about driving slow on accounts of being glad and full of thinking; so I got home a heap too quick for that length of a trip. The old gentleman was at the door, and he says:", "sha256": "38bd9359bb894013a01e62b7d09e1cb69a75608b9ee24af529fc2a1f90d67ddb", "source_location": "div.chapter[38]/*[25]", "source_html": "Then we took the trunk and put it in my wagon, and he drove off his way and I drove mine. But of course I forgot all about driving slow on accounts of being glad and full of thinking; so I got home a heap too quick for that length of a trip. The old gentleman was at the door, and he says:"}, {"id": "043-036-0026", "tag": "p", "text": "“Why, this is wonderful! Whoever would a thought it was in that mare to do it? I wish we’d a timed her. And she hain’t sweated a hair—not a hair. It’s wonderful. Why, I wouldn’t take a hundred dollars for that horse now—I wouldn’t, honest; and yet I’d a sold her for fifteen before, and thought ’twas all she was worth.”", "sha256": "e0b2fe05eedb7a69c2460e802db4e13c71d5ca78636823ba411add6f87e2d7b5", "source_location": "div.chapter[38]/*[26]", "source_html": "“Why, this is wonderful! Whoever would a thought it was in that mare to do it? I wish we’d a timed her. And she hain’t sweated a hair—not a hair. It’s wonderful. Why, I wouldn’t take a hundred dollars for that horse now—I wouldn’t, honest; and yet I’d a sold her for fifteen before, and thought ’twas all she was worth.”"}, {"id": "043-036-0027", "tag": "p", "text": "That’s all he said. He was the innocentest, best old soul I ever see. But it warn’t surprising; because he warn’t only just a farmer, he was a preacher, too, and had a little one-horse log church down back of the plantation, which he built it himself at his own expense, for a church and schoolhouse, and never charged nothing for his preaching, and it was worth it, too. There was plenty other farmer-preachers like that, and done the same way, down South.", "sha256": "f8bc3953faf89c07cecdae5e4652408ecf25f933dd0df53b8405a912ef7b47ef", "source_location": "div.chapter[38]/*[27]", "source_html": "That’s all he said. He was the innocentest, best old soul I ever see. But it warn’t surprising; because he warn’t only just a farmer, he was a preacher, too, and had a little one-horse log church down back of the plantation, which he built it himself at his own expense, for a church and schoolhouse, and never charged nothing for his preaching, and it was worth it, too. There was plenty other farmer-preachers like that, and done the same way, down South."}, {"id": "043-036-0028", "tag": "p", "text": "In about half an hour Tom’s wagon drove up to the front stile, and Aunt Sally she see it through the window, because it was only about fifty yards, and says:", "sha256": "aa9a2be8479338faa2f6c61e3f554a23c9338bce834aa9b9739ba2821bd71848", "source_location": "div.chapter[38]/*[28]", "source_html": "In about half an hour Tom’s wagon drove up to the front stile, and Aunt Sally she see it through the window, because it was only about fifty yards, and says:"}, {"id": "043-036-0029", "tag": "p", "text": "“Why, there’s somebody come! I wonder who ’tis? Why, I do believe it’s a stranger. Jimmy” (that’s one of the children) “run and tell Lize to put on another plate for dinner.”", "sha256": "66c821fdf4db38483c3a82f5f067ba14dd29413efb656940e4effd13b08755ba", "source_location": "div.chapter[38]/*[29]", "source_html": "“Why, there’s somebody come! I wonder who ’tis? Why, I do believe it’s a stranger. Jimmy” (that’s one of the children) “run and tell Lize to put on another plate for dinner.”"}, {"id": "043-036-0030", "tag": "p", "text": "Everybody made a rush for the front door, because, of course, a stranger don’t come every year, and so he lays over the yaller-fever, for interest, when he does come. Tom was over the stile and starting for the house; the wagon was spinning up the road for the village, and we was all bunched in the front door. Tom had his store clothes on, and an audience—and that was always nuts for Tom Sawyer. In them circumstances it warn’t no trouble to him to throw in an amount of style that was suitable. He warn’t a boy to meeky along up that yard like a sheep; no, he come ca’m and important, like the ram. When he got a-front of us he lifts his hat ever so gracious and dainty, like it was the lid of a box that had butterflies asleep in it and he didn’t want to disturb them, and says:", "sha256": "e4808fe94f4b5ca6136e01506744d6684e478def86919e1b609228b84a6b0151", "source_location": "div.chapter[38]/*[30]", "source_html": "Everybody made a rush for the front door, because, of course, a stranger don’t come every year, and so he lays over the yaller-fever, for interest, when he does come. Tom was over the stile and starting for the house; the wagon was spinning up the road for the village, and we was all bunched in the front door. Tom had his store clothes on, and an audience—and that was always nuts for Tom Sawyer. In them circumstances it warn’t no trouble to him to throw in an amount of style that was suitable. He warn’t a boy to meeky along up that yard like a sheep; no, he come ca’m and important, like the ram. When he got a-front of us he lifts his hat ever so gracious and dainty, like it was the lid of a box that had butterflies asleep in it and he didn’t want to disturb them, and says:"}, {"id": "043-036-0031", "tag": "p", "text": "“Mr. Archibald Nichols, I presume?”", "sha256": "030715b457b10866fa52c1d3c637b9d7320f1fcd979b8264fe951fa19409284c", "source_location": "div.chapter[38]/*[31]", "source_html": "“Mr. Archibald Nichols, I presume?”"}, {"id": "043-036-0032", "tag": "source_caption", "text": "“Mr. Archibald Nichols, I presume?”", "sha256": "030715b457b10866fa52c1d3c637b9d7320f1fcd979b8264fe951fa19409284c", "source_location": "illustration-index/#c33-287", "image_id": "c33-287"}, {"id": "043-036-0033", "tag": "p", "text": "“No, my boy,” says the old gentleman, “I’m sorry to say ’t your driver has deceived you; Nichols’s place is down a matter of three mile more. Come in, come in.”", "sha256": "2e0555c5552f07cb2cb35e717486d3e56b9de74bd42bf87cac6fc8c19bcc5f9c", "source_location": "div.chapter[38]/*[33]", "source_html": "“No, my boy,” says the old gentleman, “I’m sorry to say ’t your driver has deceived you; Nichols’s place is down a matter of three mile more. Come in, come in.”"}, {"id": "043-036-0034", "tag": "p", "text": "Tom he took a look back over his shoulder, and says, “Too late—he’s out of sight.”", "sha256": "245347238674a33ddd39882c0f8e77ce607307b63f3cf9c19b8ce1b6277a00a0", "source_location": "div.chapter[38]/*[34]", "source_html": "Tom he took a look back over his shoulder, and says, “Too late—he’s out of sight.”"}, {"id": "043-036-0035", "tag": "p", "text": "“Yes, he’s gone, my son, and you must come in and eat your dinner with us; and then we’ll hitch up and take you down to Nichols’s.”", "sha256": "3e88c735a0de11503f6490d8156c7fffe6beebc22b987b0cf34ddb1ac975baf0", "source_location": "div.chapter[38]/*[35]", "source_html": "“Yes, he’s gone, my son, and you must come in and eat your dinner with us; and then we’ll hitch up and take you down to Nichols’s.”"}, {"id": "043-036-0036", "tag": "p", "text": "“Oh, I can’t make you so much trouble; I couldn’t think of it. I’ll walk—I don’t mind the distance.”", "sha256": "843ab3d7fd1d9db323844428352a432bd65062369824e4bdbe9ea44a64999764", "source_location": "div.chapter[38]/*[36]", "source_html": "“Oh, I can’t make you so much trouble; I couldn’t think of it. I’ll walk—I don’t mind the distance.”"}, {"id": "043-036-0037", "tag": "p", "text": "“But we won’t let you walk—it wouldn’t be Southern hospitality to do it. Come right in.”", "sha256": "cbb14909555570b44752b58c75049d185d6859eed15e2e1638050756aef56099", "source_location": "div.chapter[38]/*[37]", "source_html": "“But we won’t let you walk—it wouldn’t be Southern hospitality to do it. Come right in.”"}, {"id": "043-036-0038", "tag": "p", "text": "“Oh, do,” says Aunt Sally; “it ain’t a bit of trouble to us, not a bit in the world. You must stay. It’s a long, dusty three mile, and we can’t let you walk. And, besides, I’ve already told ’em to put on another plate when I see you coming; so you mustn’t disappoint us. Come right in and make yourself at home.”", "sha256": "ffaef1346f158c2e29e3daef4d990151d157f47f8e283c2afa96b65b8282c034", "source_location": "div.chapter[38]/*[38]", "source_html": "“Oh, do,” says Aunt Sally; “it ain’t a bit of trouble to us, not a bit in the world. You must stay. It’s a long, dusty three mile, and we can’t let you walk. And, besides, I’ve already told ’em to put on another plate when I see you coming; so you mustn’t disappoint us. Come right in and make yourself at home.”"}, {"id": "043-036-0039", "tag": "p", "text": "So Tom he thanked them very hearty and handsome, and let himself be persuaded, and come in; and when he was in he said he was a stranger from Hicksville, Ohio, and his name was William Thompson—and he made another bow.", "sha256": "3a6eb063073cd64916d697f56a4e173811bdd9b83ac90af2300a321ddb152c0a", "source_location": "div.chapter[38]/*[39]", "source_html": "So Tom he thanked them very hearty and handsome, and let himself be persuaded, and come in; and when he was in he said he was a stranger from Hicksville, Ohio, and his name was William Thompson—and he made another bow."}], "final_rows": [{"source_id": "043-036-0020", "target": "— Я *помогу* тебе его украсть!", "source_sha256": "6964c02c4db15a9201ff9acfab49f45975f4f6aa3b982f8bbb9531634cc0fba0", "target_id": "ru-043-036-0020", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "19ea3108dea66a45f9e739603c3f985b612bec9d456141c6cfb2190fc9684cb8"}, {"source_id": "043-036-0021", "target": "Тут я разжал все хватки, будто меня подстрелили. Более изумительной речи я в жизни не слыхал — и, надо сказать, Том Сойер сильно упал в моих глазах. Только я не мог этому поверить. Том Сойер — *вор негров!*", "source_sha256": "409e4201b961b09c053f220da071285e763787b1754d3f4b8f4a21762cef070e", "target_id": "ru-043-036-0021", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "878f937bbab01442c317ce8ed1c316aedfd2a93f4608eb35f6a047fa6c5376f9"}, {"source_id": "043-036-0022", "target": "— Ой, брось! — говорю я. — Ты шутишь.", "source_sha256": "0938bf685b92a71fa10d0bf54dea8b19db5355614698cc3e09737d548e945b20", "target_id": "ru-043-036-0022", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "da1de70945e905af5b133c8139772dbaea031f9c87e7aa0c1fd30dba33f762fb"}, {"source_id": "043-036-0023", "target": "— И вовсе не шучу.", "source_sha256": "ba7ef2b03a95a327069eaae4f86032bed0ea711993dfe4721bc5530fd1368149", "target_id": "ru-043-036-0023", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "90c41a960d1b6592a1ad29d6f7774dc09ad8551d19852dbcc2ae8ecdfa0f4fed"}, {"source_id": "043-036-0024", "target": "— Ну так вот, — говорю я, — шутишь или не шутишь, а если услышишь что-нибудь про беглого негра, не забудь помнить, что *ты* ничего про него не знаешь, и *я* ничего про него не знаю.", "source_sha256": "63d9c1f08705479c340da3822e32bb0a7b429477f84770929d619abee79693cf", "target_id": "ru-043-036-0024", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "ee18237553c3c424f74d61ad333027a5086fd7325f2da63e65204d53206dd8d3"}, {"source_id": "043-036-0025", "target": "Потом мы взяли сундук и поставили его в мою повозку, и он поехал своей дорогой, а я своей. Только я, конечно, совсем забыл, что надо ехать медленно: уж очень был рад и погружён в думы; так что домой я приехал куда быстрее, чем полагалось для такого пути. Старый джентльмен стоял у двери и говорит:", "source_sha256": "38bd9359bb894013a01e62b7d09e1cb69a75608b9ee24af529fc2a1f90d67ddb", "target_id": "ru-043-036-0025", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "fc77619cacadf1a80b42fce6cd7cd63d131e2bfdec45503def2579c93545a953"}, {"source_id": "043-036-0026", "target": "— Да это просто чудо! Кто бы мог подумать, что в этой кобыле такая прыть? Жаль, что мы не засекли время. И ни волоска не вспотела — ни единого. Чудо, да и только. Да я бы теперь за эту лошадь и сто долларов не взял — честное слово; а ведь прежде продал бы за пятнадцать и думал, что больше она не стоит.", "source_sha256": "e0b2fe05eedb7a69c2460e802db4e13c71d5ca78636823ba411add6f87e2d7b5", "target_id": "ru-043-036-0026", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "bff82e4995b6dfd78e5070f3ddc5f16767751147f55dca7a4d2b661318309b41"}, {"source_id": "043-036-0027", "target": "Вот и всё, что он сказал. Это был самый безобидный и добрый старик, какого я только видел. Но удивляться тут нечему: он ведь был не просто фермер, а ещё и проповедник, и у него позади плантации стояла маленькая бревенчатая церквушка на одну лошадь, которую он сам построил на свои деньги под церковь и школу, и за проповеди никогда ничего не брал, а они того и стоили. Таких фермеров-проповедников на Юге было порядочно, и все делали так же.", "source_sha256": "f8bc3953faf89c07cecdae5e4652408ecf25f933dd0df53b8405a912ef7b47ef", "target_id": "ru-043-036-0027", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "659eb02ab5c5c2dfba00d91bb282e6e99e5968bfaa37bcdfa4871b5b4df7d2dc"}, {"source_id": "043-036-0028", "target": "Примерно через полчаса повозка Тома подъехала к передней лесенке через ограду, и тётя Салли увидела её в окно, потому что до неё было всего ярдов пятьдесят, и говорит:", "source_sha256": "aa9a2be8479338faa2f6c61e3f554a23c9338bce834aa9b9739ba2821bd71848", "target_id": "ru-043-036-0028", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "7130d5e93c469391303bce7ebb61edc01860160ba29d5776b051d7e2534ca0a7"}, {"source_id": "043-036-0029", "target": "— Смотрите-ка, кто-то приехал! Интересно, кто бы это? Да это, кажется, чужой. Джимми, — (это один из детей), — беги скажи Лайзе, чтоб поставила к обеду ещё одну тарелку.", "source_sha256": "66c821fdf4db38483c3a82f5f067ba14dd29413efb656940e4effd13b08755ba", "target_id": "ru-043-036-0029", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "e71bc5ae812a9873b3da83bc3d5c75f25bdd2ea38418318feea079c6e0147ceb"}, {"source_id": "043-036-0030", "target": "Все кинулись к парадной двери, потому что чужой, ясное дело, приезжает не *каждый* год, и когда уж приезжает, интересу от него больше, чем от жёлтой лихорадки. Том перелез через ограду и пошёл к дому; повозка бойко катила по дороге к деревне, а мы все столпились в дверях. На Томе была выходная одежда, и зрители были тоже — а для Тома Сойера это всегда было лакомство. При таких обстоятельствах ему ничего не стоило напустить на себя подходящую важность. Он не из тех мальчишек, что плетутся по двору смирненько, как овца; нет, он шёл спокойно и важно, как баран. Когда он подошёл к нам, то снял шляпу так милостиво и тонко, будто это была крышка коробки, в которой спят бабочки, и он не хотел их разбудить, и говорит:", "source_sha256": "e4808fe94f4b5ca6136e01506744d6684e478def86919e1b609228b84a6b0151", "target_id": "ru-043-036-0030", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "000fdfdbaddb7b8611773ddc3865bfaea2c2e07ea77fc07b9bd801f30b0f8c78"}, {"source_id": "043-036-0031", "target": "— Мистер Арчибальд Николс, если не ошибаюсь?", "source_sha256": "030715b457b10866fa52c1d3c637b9d7320f1fcd979b8264fe951fa19409284c", "target_id": "ru-043-036-0031", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "0a446df19a2f90b04714781067be1b62f95497ba100a5e9fb7ab0b3cf04d63ee"}, {"source_id": "043-036-0032", "target": "«Мистер Арчибальд Николс, если не ошибаюсь?»", "source_sha256": "030715b457b10866fa52c1d3c637b9d7320f1fcd979b8264fe951fa19409284c", "target_id": "ru-043-036-0032", "tag": "source_caption", "target_sha256": "0b04803db7afab21604839aab5d932723ec2d06964769d53c2b95a5007b4b0f8"}, {"source_id": "043-036-0033", "target": "— Нет, мой мальчик, — говорит старый джентльмен, — к сожалению, твой возница ввёл тебя в заблуждение; усадьба Николса ещё милях в трёх отсюда.
